sentiment.rationale: Full-year comparable sales guidance was lowered to 'roughly flat' from the bottom end of the previous range, and adjusted EPS guidance was reduced to approximately $12.25 (2% growth) from a prior expectation of higher growth. Management explicitly cites 'a cautious consumer amid ongoing uncertainty in the macro environment' and notes that 'the timing of an inflection in the home improvement and housing markets remains unclear.' This downward revision and cautious forward language justify a mildly negative score.

summary.revenue: $20.8 billion, comparable sales +0.4% year-over-year, with a roughly 100 basis point headwind from Hurricanes Helene and Milton.
summary.eps: GAAP diluted EPS $2.88; adjusted diluted EPS $3.06, a 6% increase versus prior-year quarter.
summary.guidance: Full-year comparable sales expected roughly flat (bottom end of previous guidance); total sales approximately $86 billion including FBM; adjusted operating margin approximately 12.1%; adjusted diluted EPS approximately $12.25 (2% growth); capital expenditures up to $2.5 billion.
summary.margin: Adjusted operating margin 12.4% in Q3, up 10 basis points year-over-year. Full-year adjusted operating margin expected approximately 12.1%.
